detour_factor.source: measured - shortest path over the observed A1 road graph
detour_factor.note: aggregate ratio of summed network to summed straight-line distance over population-weighted zone pairs; the sweep is the interquartile range of the per-pair ratios extended to hold the aggregate (iqr carries the range alone)

day_type.source: measured - RMS traffic counts, WEEKENDS vs WEEKDAYS period
day_type.note: vehicle volume, not person trips: it fixes the weekday/weekend ratio but says nothing about how the weekend splits between Saturday and Sunday, which stays assumed and swept

work_attendance.source: measured - census 2021 G62, used as a sweep LOWER BOUND only
work_attendance.note: census night was August 2021 and 19.2% worked from home, so this carries the lockdown with it. DECISIONS.md 2.4 already rules G62 out as a behavioural rate; it bounds the P_MANDATORY sweep from below rather than setting it.

walk.source: measured - shortest path over the observed A6 active network unioned with every road class a pedestrian may use, between population-weighted origins and observed POI destinations
walk.note: sampled at the observed walk trip length between population-weighted origins and observed POI destinations; the aggregate ratio of summed path to summed straight-line distance, with the sweep the interquartile range of the per-pair ratios extended to hold the aggregate (iqr carries the range alone)

bike.source: measured - shortest path over the observed A6 active network unioned with every road class a pedestrian may use, between population-weighted origins and observed POI destinations
bike.note: sampled at the observed bike trip length between population-weighted origins and observed POI destinations; the aggregate ratio of summed path to summed straight-line distance, with the sweep the interquartile range of the per-pair ratios extended to hold the aggregate (iqr carries the range alone)
